data.name: 1.5 Day Spearfishing Charter
data.headline: A trip you'll never forget
data.description:
Southern California has some incredible fishing and it's no secret. This is the trip that will get you far offshore, beyond the range of all day boats and onto some serious fishing grounds. All that travel time happens while you are asleep in an oversized bunk on a heavy and stable boat, so all the daylight hours can be used for hunting. This excursion is a completely different feel from running and gunning on a center console, and is designed to maximize your diving time and comfort.

Our group (up to 4 divers) will travel up to 100 miles offshore in search of large pelagic fish, including the sought after Blue Fin Tuna. The Escapade is an absolute menace and has everything we could possibly need to reach, find, land, and store fish, all while staying comfortable when it's time to recover. The boat features include:


Through hull extending side scan sonar
Refrigerated fish hold
Oversized bait tanks
Outdoor shower with hot freshwater
4 oversized bunks (has comfortably slept 6'5 tall guests)
Full refrigerator/freezer
Electric griddle, instapot, toaster oven, coffee maker, microwave, sink
Full bathroom/head
Radar, sonar, updated navionics

Twin John Deere 275hp Diesel engines (2022)
Northern lights generator
Bunks for captain and deck hand in wheel house

The licensed captain as well as the deck hand/safety diver are both freediving instructors and spearfishing guides with years of hunting these waters, and teaching people how to safely freedive and spearfish. Whether you want pointers on your technique, someone to safety you for deeper drops, a second shot to back you up, or just someone to help you pull your fish in the boat, we've got you covered.
data.itinerary:
Meet in the late afternoon at Dana Landing. We will travel overnight to the fishing grounds, then spend all day diving. After that we set course for home and are back in the morning.

We typically run out and back at night to give you a full day of diving. If you'd rather leave in the morning and get back in the evening of the next day we can do that as well. We will spend both days driving around looking for kelp paddies and any tuna that might be in range. If you'd prefer this schedule please let us know and we can adjust

data.booking_notes:
Thanks for booking your 1.5-day spearfishing trip with us aboard *Escapade*! We're stoked to have you onboard for a solid offshore run.

Here’s everything you need to know before we head out:

---

**🚤 Trip Overview**  
- **Pickup Location:** Dana Landing, Mission Bay  
- **Parking:** Please park at the **Freedom Boat Club lot**  
   - 📍 [Freedom Boat Club – Mission Bay Location](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Freedom+Boat+Club+San+Diego/@32.761884,-117.239007,17z)  
- We’ll **depart in the evening**, traveling overnight while you sleep.  
- You’ll wake up offshore, ready to dive at first light.  
- After a **full day of diving**, we’ll head back overnight and return **early the next morning**.

---

**🧳 What to Bring**  
- **California fishing license** – required for all spearfishing and fishing  
- **Your own dive gear**  
- A **pillowcase** (we provide the pillows)  
- **Sleeping bag or linens** for your bunk (a sleeping bag usually works best)  
- **Warm layers** – nights on the water can get chilly, and there’s nothing worse than being cold at sea  
- **Fishing rods** (optional, but you're welcome to bring them)  
- **One dive bag + one dry bag** with clothes and personal items is usually perfect  
- Any **specialty snacks or alcoholic beverages** you’d like to bring (we’ll have food and drinks covered)

---

**🎯 Gear Availability**  
We’ll have a selection of **tuna guns with full setups**, as well as **mid-range guns** that are great for kelp paddies and island diving—ideal for species like yellowtail, white seabass, and mahi mahi.  
Just let us know in advance what you’ll need so we can be sure it’s onboard.

---

**🍽 Food & Dietary Notes**  
If you have any **food allergies or dietary restrictions**, please let us know ahead of time so we can plan accordingly.

---

**💵 Gratuity**  
If you enjoy the trip, **tips for the crew are always appreciated**. Never expected, but they go a long way and mean a lot to us.

---

We’re looking forward to a killer trip filled with good dives, good people, and good times. If you have any questions before we head out, just shoot us a message.

See you soon!

Best,
